status: PASS bounded public Graph and actual Model/Session retirement journeys
scope: Original Vulkan accepted work, partial-submit failure, unknown native observation, owner teardown and explicit retry; Apple protocol audit and actual relocated-gate compile. Not a GPU-preemption or complete hardware/error matrix claim.

repairs.blocking_retirement: Context::drain drives the original Vulkan queue without closing future admission. An abandoned accepted prefix that needs QueueWaitIdle cannot be retired by collect(false) polling.
repairs.diagnosis_vs_retirement: Unknown fence/drain status retains guards and native owners. Typed in-flight/attachment state, rather than error status, decides retirement. One Model handoff attempt replaces unbounded abort polling.
repairs.controller_ownership: All public Vulkan raw allocation/import/export tokens and typed native Buffer allocations retain their exact original MemoryState. Zero-size raw buffers are covered. Public wrapper layout and native handles are unchanged.
repairs.callback_reentry: Blocking drain/close from the same Runtime retirement callback is rejected. The original native Run tail still owns its Runtime; no callback joins its own unfinished publication.
repairs.cold_resources: One finite engine-private ColdResources scope holds original weights, pools, schema, count/inventory policy addresses, families, IO and literals. A preallocated node per serial carrier attaches the scope to the original CompletionRetention without per-token heap allocation.
repairs.application_links: Model teardown invalidates Session.model_ and candidate_admission host links, releases Invocation application roots, and hands the original Backend to the scope. Session can explicitly retry its original retirement continuation.
repairs.destruction_order: The scope owns Backend as its first field so payloads die before their resource controller. Model declares/initializes Backend before resources_ for constructor unwind, and always hands it off on normal or unresolved teardown. Snapshot carries the scope for escaped raw policy/count borrows.
repairs.gate_route: Relocated native private includes are corrected. macOS gate source selection follows the actual Apple route, allowing a Vulkan-only macOS configuration rather than inferring route from host OS.

cases: Real native/managed accepted prefix, rejected next native submit, abandoned Completion; nonclosing drain retires and a fresh Graph uses the same Context.
Unknown original queue idle retains guards; an explicit later original-queue retry retires them.
Raw allocation/ReadLease, readonly import, typed Tensor with budget/view and zero-byte raw Buffer outlive MemoryResource wrappers.
Retirement callback cannot block on its own publication; the outer original drain still retires correctly.
Synchronous device IO preserves its first observation diagnosis after the next real fence proves retirement; native owners and controller release.

actual_model_session.fault_boundary: Accept the original whole Graph first; then withhold terminal fence/wait/idle observations, drop the public Completion and destroy Model.
cases: Session keeps original native scope after Model destruction; unknown retry retains it, restored native observation retires it, last Session releases scope and Runtime.

Model and Session both die while work remains unknown; the original accepted attachment alone keeps the scope. Its real final callback releases the scope without self-join, cycle or application owner.

Apple.queue_admission: apple_context.cc:167,1532: enqueue accepts an original host FIFO Job and pins leases before queueing. This is not proof that GPU kernels have started.
Apple.execution_retirement: apple_context.cc:678: pre-execution cancellation can skip math; accepted partial evaluation is synchronized on the original stream before failure publication. :649-716 retires native leases before publishing terminal/completion callbacks.
Apple.existing_gate_boundary: The Apple gate holds the original worker and observes a queued successor. Its cancellation proof is queued admission, not native GPU preemption.
Apple.resource_controller: Apple MemoryState self-retention and its two actual lifetime tests were implemented by the parallel scope audit; use its separate evidence/object identity, not this gate compile as a resource-runtime proof.

Vulkan.partial_acceptance: vulkan_run.cc:660 marks needs_drain after a real accepted prefix. :300 requires blocking queue proof; nonblocking collect alone cannot discharge it.
Vulkan.explicit_blocking_API: Native Completion::wait still blocks/retries until terminal proof. Context::drain and Model abort handoff return unknown diagnosis with retained owners; no claim that every wait API now returns after one unknown observation.
Vulkan.concurrency: Model execution_slot_count remains1. N/R admission/batch sizes do not imply concurrent independent native Model invocations.

The bounded runner was stopped (exit4294967295); source and logs retained. limitations: Unknown driver failures do not promise automatic retirement; actual owners remain attached until the original endpoint can establish a terminal state.
No GPU preemption, arbitrary multi-GPU placement, exhaustive cancellation cross-product or throughput improvement is claimed.
Constructor-unwind field ordering and escaped Snapshot resource ownership are compiled and reviewed; there is no separate partial-loader exception-injection runtime case in this proof.
The synchronous DeviceIO regression observes a first failed wait/idle followed by a real fence; its normal wait contract does not expose a returned unretired IO call after one observation failure.
No whole-model Apple destructor/unknown-driver fault journey is inferred from the Apple source audit or gate compile.
